instruction: A candid wide-angle documentary photograph of a motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the left, the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) leans forward, extending her right hand to touch the chest of the bearded man in a black t-shirt and blue shorts (R1), who stands on the right facing away from the camera. The scene is lit by bright overhead fluorescent lights against white walls.
elements: R2 leans forward and extends her right hand to touch R1's chest
R1 is the contact target whose chest is touched by R2
R2 initiates the hand-to-chest contact while R1 stands facing away
R2's right hand is the contacting body part and R1's chest is the contacted body part
the scene is a motion capture studio with a red carpet

questions.q: Is R2 extending her right hand to touch R1's chest, rather than R1 extending his hand to touch R2's chest?
questions.element: R2 initiates hand-to-chest contact on R1

questions.q: Is R1 the person whose chest is being touched by R2, rather than R2 being the person whose chest is touched by R1?
questions.element: R1 is the contacted person and R2 is the toucher

questions.q: Does R2 lean forward toward R1 to make the chest contact, rather than R1 leaning forward toward R2 to make that contact?
questions.element: R2 leans forward to initiate contact with R1

questions.q: Is R2's right hand the body part used to contact R1's chest?
questions.element: R2's right hand contacts R1's chest
